name: siyuan-drawio-plugin
description: Draw.io integrated as a plugin into Siyuan
author: cowboy

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n src,client-pre,client-post -c blue,green,yellow "cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline vite build --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline CLIENT_ENTRY=PreConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts --watch" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline CLIENT_ENTRY=PostConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts --watch"
scripts.dev:client: cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline CLIENT_ENTRY=PreConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts --watch && cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline CLIENT_ENTRY=PostConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts --watch
scripts.dev:client:pre: cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline CLIENT_ENTRY=PreConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts --watch
scripts.dev:client:post: cross-env NODE_ENV=development VITE_SOURCEMAP=inline CLIENT_ENTRY=PostConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts --watch
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_ENTRY=PreConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_ENTRY=PostConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts
scripts.build:client: cross-env NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_ENTRY=PreConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_ENTRY=PostConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts
scripts.build:client:pre: cross-env NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_ENTRY=PreConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts
scripts.build:client:post: cross-env NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_ENTRY=PostConfig vite build --config vite.client.config.ts
